criteriaForNine: Restore coherent soft surface treatment on the moth and clear material distinctions in the environment, using 07 as a visible control rather than applying a blanket blur. Retain 11's intended eye correction, lighting, scene layout and tiny anatomy.
Make the workshop mitten clearly hold one continuous hammer handle; maintain compact anatomy and the existing action.

Confirm that these local corrections do not disturb the successful whole-frame hierarchy at native, 1280, 880 and 420 widths. A 9 would be earned by cleaner visible craft, not by adding cameos, increasing saturation or assuming audience approval.

strengths: The large cream face, dark glasses, laptop and exclusive bench make the foreground worker the strongest grouping at all three supplied scales. No companion intrudes on that bench or the foreground route.
The tree/canopy frame and receding path connect the resting, making and laptop-work vignettes. Workshop and tree companions provide secondary discoveries without displacing the hero.

The warm directional light, softer distant bridge/water and blurred foreground foliage give the scene depth. Environment and characters share a dimensional treatment; they do not look like separate flat logos pasted on a landscape.

At 420px the overall coding/resting/making atmosphere survives, while small cameo identities and exact hand actions become incidental. Indistinct optional detail is not itself an access defect or a reason to require enlargement.

The original V5's large pale head, compact body, green marked wings and unequal antennae remain recognizable as the construction reference. Different activities do not require mature or elongated anatomy.
The enlarged companion crop visibly shows dark Muse eyes and flat pale Grok ovals without an interior pupil. That local observation does not pre-approve the rest of the frame.

The difference is visible in the actual full images and paired native crops; I do not infer degradation merely from the history of repeated edits. I prefer 07 as the finish control while retaining the specific intended corrections from 11, not as an instruction to restore rejected eye details.
